title: Request for adding "surname" to the list of values for the attribute "autocomplete" of "text" inputs

labels.name: needs implementer interest
labels.description: Moving the issue forward requires implementers to express interest

labels.name: i18n-tracker
labels.description: Group bringing to attention of Internationalization, or tracked by i18n but not needing response.

body:
Currently, there is a "family-name" value for the "autocomplete" attribute of text inputs, but there is no "surname" value. Both are important in Germany and the second is important internationally.

In Germany, families are identified on bell shields, postal boxes and the like. The family name on those shields are the shared name in a German family (let's say "Schmidt") or a combination of people's surnames in foreign families or unmarried couples (let's say "Martín-Gonzales Pérez-Perón" for a Spanish couple with double surnames). In turn, if people aim at identifying themselves, not their families, they use a surname instead ("Name" not "Familienname"). The surname is either the family name or the closest to that in the original country according to Federal Ministry of Internal Affairs (BMI). Similarly, internationally, the surname is the name segment that most countries display separately on a pass, no matter whether it is a family name like in Germany, two clan names like in Portuguese and Spanish speaking countries ("clan" in the sense of all relatives from one side including cousins, uncles/aunts, and grandparents), a patronymic/matronymic like in Iceland, or a surname of choice like in countries with Common Law.

Since the "surname" is a standing compromise between different naming systems in different countries, I suggest we add it and promote it as the most useful name segment together with the given name for internationalization. However, this does not mean that family-names, clan-names, and patronymics are irrelevant. For instance, in Germany it would make sense for a renovation company to ask for the family name when specifying the address of the apartment that needs renovation. In the case of the Spanish couple above, that would be "Martín-Gonzales Pérez-Perón". This family name should be used to autofill family name fields for all related purposes, whenever it is relevant to identify the family and the family's apartment. However, when both married and unmarried Germans as well as foreigners need to identify themselves, this value should not be used. There we should have either "Martín-Gonzales" or "Pérez-Perón" separately assuming that these people use different devices.
